title: Name a resource
summary: REST API Development: Name a resource. Write a URL for book 2.
introduction: A resource is a thing an API exposes. /books/1 names one book, while /books names a collection.
learningObjectives: Name a resource with REST API Development

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Name a resource
blocks.code:
GET /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":1,"title":"Moon Trip"}

blocks.text: The final path segment identifies book 1. The 200 status and JSON body show that the read succeeded.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use resource names clearly; a URL should identify what is being addressed.
